vsx_table.description: AAVSO VSX: name, ra, dec, type, period for every object; fetched 2026-11-10 in strips and checked against VizieR's row count

survey_ledger.description: the survey's private SQLite ledger, opened read-only; snapshot 2026-11-11. Its content used here is data/catalogue.parquet (every signal) and the searched-star lists in data/inputs/.

stored_light_curves.description: the survey's stored, conditioned TGLC light curves (private, about 13 GB). Their content used here is data/inputs/ephem_refined.parquet.

gaia_dr3.description: IRSA TAP gaia_dr3_source columns for signal stars and a seeded quiet sample: data/inputs/dr3_columns.parquet

kepler.description: MAST stpubdata bucket: the list of Kepler targets with light curves (data/inputs/kepler_targets.txt) and two long-cadence quarters per sampled target, streamed and reduced to data/inputs/kepler_labels.parquet; no raw file was kept

rebuild_from_deposit: build_items.py (with the VSX table) -> purity_dr3.py -> build_predictions.py; kepler_plan.py and kepler_calib.py are recorded but their outputs are frozen inputs
